//: Versions for the packages the generator writes into a new project and this
repository does not itself use: the NestJS API, the React page, and pg for a
project with a database. In link-shortener these came from apps/*/package.json,
because the product happened to contain one of everything. This repository
is the harness alone, so they are recorded here, once, at the versions the
templates in scripts/harness-templates.mjs were written against.
Only what no package.json here can give a version for. A name that is also
in package.json is refused, by the resolver and by harness-package.spec.ts:
two copies of a version drift, which is why harness.manifest.json records
packages and never versions. Bump a version here only after generating a
project with it and watching that project's gate go green.
